title: SECOND SPEAKER
format: Vertical 9:16, 53 seconds, 1080 by 1920 at 24 fps, invented-language dialogue with subtitles
logline: An old woman teaches a small device the language only she speaks, and the subtitles arrive as it learns. Then her granddaughter, who has been practising with it, says hello.
overall: Published 2026-11-23: https://youtube.com/shorts/bIkdaWMxbH8. The director approved v1 without notes; the 4K master of that cut is the published file.

scenes.title: The porch
scenes.summary: Late afternoon on a plain timber porch. She talks to the device beside her, easily. We understand none of it.

segments.title: S01 She talks to the device
segments.detail: Wide, locked off. She says the film's one sentence; nothing is subtitled.

scenes.title: It learns
scenes.summary: The device gets a word wrong, she corrects it, and it gets it right. The film's first subtitle arrives on that word.

segments.title: S02a The correction
segments.detail: The device gets the word wrong; she says 'not like that' and gives it the word slowly.

segments.title: S10 The device answers
segments.detail: Close on the device, its light driven by its voice. The first subtitle arrives here: evening light.

segments.title: S02c The whole sentence
segments.detail: Subtitled with gaps for the three words the device does not have yet.

segments.title: S03 The light on the field
segments.detail: The device says the sentence back over the field and the subtitle completes word by word.

scenes.title: The granddaughter
scenes.summary: Her room, three short pieces of different days, practising with the same kind of device. It corrects her the way it was corrected.

segments.title: S04 At the desk, night
segments.detail: She makes the device's old mistake; it answers with the right stress.

segments.title: S05 On the floor by the window
segments.detail: The sentence, with a hesitation in the middle.

scenes.title: Second speaker
scenes.summary: The porch at dusk, the woman alone, the device dark. A voice behind her says hello in her language, badly. The scene ends on her face.

segments.title: S11 Alone at dusk
segments.detail: Added shot: she sits by herself, the device dark.

segments.title: S07 Hello, Grandma
segments.detail: From behind her; the granddaughter walks up and says it. Subtitled.

segments.title: S08 Her face
segments.detail: Hand to her mouth, then the smile. No reply. Cropped in slightly to lose a dark shape at the frame edge.

scenes.title: Evening light
scenes.summary: A slow fade to the two of them on the porch, seen from the field, looking at the light and talking. We cannot make out the words.

segments.title: S09 The two of them
segments.detail: Slow dissolve from her face. Two low voices, indistinct, not subtitled. Title, fade out.

decisions.title: Who are they?
decisions.detail: Director, 2026-11-22: "Good call. Include one that is more obscure Balkan or Macedonian area kind of feel." Three candidate pairs will be generated as stills; the pick stays open until he has seen them. The rule on cultural signifiers is unchanged. Stills delivered 2026-11-22: A upland (the Balkan-feel pair), B farmhouse, C long grass. Director, 2026-11-22: "Pair C."

decisions.title: How old is the granddaughter?
decisions.detail: Director, 2026-11-22: "Yep, 20 works." He does not want to work around the motion model's limits on generating children.

decisions.title: The words
decisions.detail: Director, 2026-11-22: "The lexicon works for me." The collision check then replaced four words that matched a people's name or a real language (see the brief): the set is now noréla, lena doví, suvé, ilo, vea, voké ru. He may still change any by ear.

decisions.title: Does she answer?
decisions.detail: Director, 2026-11-22: "End 4 on her face, then cut to a slow fade of the two sitting on the porch looking at the evening light and talking indistinctly." No reply line; the coda is scene 5.

decisions.title: All voices dubbed
decisions.detail: Director, 2026-11-22: "Use ElevenLabs for all the voices, dub them over the video." The device is voice-over; on-camera lines are converted from a guide performance so the timing holds, as on No Enemy.

decisions.title: Which voices?
decisions.detail: Director, 2026-11-22: granddaughter-3 and device-2. For the grandmother he named one from each register, grandmother-1-1 (low and dry) and grandmother-2-3 (bright and quick); both are kept and will be compared on her first real line before one is chosen. Settled by his approval of v1, which uses grandmother-1-1.

decisions.title: Budget
decisions.detail: Director set a whole-film ceiling on 2026-11-22. The amount and the ledger stay in the workspace.

decisions.title: Grandmother: low or bright?
decisions.detail: Director after watching v1, 2026-11-22: "Perfect. Absolutely perfect. Zero notes or edits. 4k upscale please." The approved draft uses the low, dry voice (grandmother-1-1). The bright-voice cut is kept in the workspace, unused.

decisions.title: 53 seconds
decisions.detail: Director after watching v1, 2026-11-22: "Perfect. Absolutely perfect. Zero notes or edits. 4k upscale please." The film stays at 53 seconds.

decisions.title: Music?
decisions.detail: Director after watching v1, 2026-11-22: "Perfect. Absolutely perfect. Zero notes or edits. 4k upscale please." No music: voices, field and room only.

log.text: Brainstormed three ideas with the director; SECOND SPEAKER chosen to build first. The director added the granddaughter's practice montage and set the depiction constraints. Brief v1 and this page written; nothing generated.

Director answered the first decisions: granddaughter about twenty, ending on the grandmother's face plus a porch coda, all voices dubbed with ElevenLabs, one Balkan-feel casting option. Lexicon checked against real languages and four words replaced. Brief v2.
Budget authorized. Six casting stills (three pairs) and twelve voice previews generated and published on the casting page for the director's pick.
Director chose pair C, granddaughter-3, device-2 and two grandmother candidates. Eleven scene anchors generated; shooting script written around one sentence; first wave of five takes submitted.

Thirteen takes generated, all kept. All lines dubbed by speech-to-speech from each take's guide performance; device lines from text. Draft v1 cut (53.1 s) with subtitles, the device light keyed to its voice, a dissolve into the coda and the title. Join review recorded.
Director approved v1 with zero notes and authorized the 4K. Voice, length and music are settled as the draft stands. 4K master v1-4k built and verified; description written.
Director published the film and supplied the link. Closeout: records, clip backup and offload, archive, source commit.
